messages:
Harper (Finance): Quick flag from ResilientLabs - their private deployment invoice shows a 'reseller_pass_through' charge and an unexpected platform surcharge. Can billing triage?
Mika (Billing): Pulling invoice 91234. There's line items: RESELLER_PASS_THROUGH 3000, PLATFORM_SURCHARGE 1200, PLATFORM_FEE 4800. The reseller line should've been netted vs platform fee per partner contract.
Sam (Customer Success): Customer says partner (CloudOps Inc) handled payment and the invoice to them should be only platform_net (platform fee minus reseller passthrough). They were billed full platform + passthrough.
Vera (Partner Ops): Partner contract (PO-4419) specifies partner remits passthrough and we invoice net platform fee. Looks like our partner_flip flag wasn't set for this account after migration.
Mika (Billing): Snapshot of invoice lines:
```
line_id,desc,amount
301,PLATFORM_FEE,4800
302,RESELLER_PASS_THROUGH,3000
303,PLATFORM_SURCHARGE,1200
```
System currently sums all. Expected behavior: invoice should show PLATFORM_NET = PLATFORM_FEE - RESELLER_PASS_THROUGH = 1800, and no passthrough line.
Harper (Finance): Net difference for customer is +3000 they shouldn't have paid. Also platform surcharge 1200 was added by a policy rule tied to support-tier 'Enterprise' but customer is on 'Enterprise - partner billed' which should exempt surcharge.
Mika (Billing): Proposed remediation: 1) Issue credit memo CM-6120 for 4200 (3000 passthrough + 1200 surcharge), 2) regenerate invoice with partner_flip flag, 3) create billing fix ticket BILL-8710 to restore partner flags during account migration. Approve?
Vera (Partner Ops): Approve. We'll also notify CloudOps Inc and include a corrected remit summary so accounting lines match for their AP.
Sam (Customer Success): I'll message the customer and confirm AP details. They want updated invoice before their month-end close. Can billing do EOD?
Mika (Billing): I'll generate corrected invoice and CM today. BillingBot: Credit memo CM-6120 created by Mika at 2065432205. Ticket BILL-8710 opened.
Harper (Finance): Keep the credit tagged 'partner_passthrough_error' so ARR/ACV reconciliation ignores it. Close loop when invoice and partner notification sent.
